lcc_original: 水勢比山漲高二十二尺半，山嶺都被淹沒了。
notes: UNV clusters verb (WH01396+WTH8804) and noun (WH04325) together on 水勢; LCC grammatically separates them so WH04325 attaches to 水勢 (noun) and WH01396+WTH8804 attach to 漲高 (verb).
מִלְמַעְלָה (WAH04480+WAH09001+WH04605 = upward/above) is embedded in the 比山漲高 phrase; all three attached to 漲高 as the verb phrase captures the upward direction.
LCC converts 十五肘 (15 cubits, WH02568+WH06240+WH0520) to 二十二尺半 (22.5 chi); per rule 6 all three SNs attach to the equivalent converted phrase as a unit.
